_schema.desc: A8 中性音樂創意庫（不綁任何供應商）。歌詞為我們資產；每引擎 prompt 只是可攜變體。

fields.vibe: 白話 vibe 描述（給人看，決定情緒/節奏）
fields.style_tags: 風格標籤陣列（中性，可對應各引擎）
fields.lyrics_reviewed: 已過 a8_lyrics_engine 審查的歌詞（結構標籤 [Chorus]/[Verse]/[Outro]）
fields.engine_prompts: 各引擎風格 prompt 變體：suno / suno_variants / minimax / fal（中性可攜）

entries.concept: 托嬰畢業典禮甜點桌，歡樂中帶溫馨，把場景寫成歡快中文饒舌
entries.vibe: 歡樂、可愛、俏皮；暖色調；甜點桌為主角；30s Short；副歌洗腦、Verse 點名餐點；避開業主/賓客臉
entries.lyrics_reviewed:
[Chorus]
邦尼兔 畢業啦 今天最神氣
甜點桌 一擺開 全場都歡喜
小小的手 抓一塊小酥皮
MAPLAB 台南外燴 甜進心坎裡
[Verse]
畢業帽 歪歪戴 樣子超可愛
蛋塔 杯子蛋糕 排排站好乖
兔子餅乾 咬一口 喀滋脆到嗨
小朋友 踮起腳 笑容藏不來
[Outro]
邦尼兔 畢業啦 記得這一天
MAPLAB 陪你長大 甜甜的畫面

brand_safety.notes: a8_lyrics_engine 過：無禁用詞/無敏感國旗政治/客戶名已置入；含 台南外燴+MAPLAB；結構 [Chorus]/[Verse]/[Outro]

engine_prompts.suno: Chinese hip-hop, boom bap, playful and warm, male rap verses with a catchy sung hook, jazzy piano, boom bap drums, light vinyl crackle, around 90 BPM, clear natural Mandarin vocals

suno_variants.trap: Chinese trap, warm and playful, male rap, 808 bass and crisp hi-hats, around 140 BPM, clear Mandarin vocals
suno_variants.lofi: Chinese lo-fi hip hop, cozy and nostalgic, soft vocal, mellow keys and brushed drums, around 75 BPM, clear Mandarin vocals

engine_prompts.minimax: Chinese hip-hop boom bap, playful and warm, male rap with sung hook, jazzy piano, around 90 BPM (prompt=style; lyrics 另填)
engine_prompts.fal: same as minimax (text-to-music: prompt=style, lyrics=歌詞)
